title: My grandparents' farm
instructions: Selin dedesiyle büyükannesinin çiftliğini anlatıyor. Hayvanlara ve yapılan işlere dikkat et.

script.speaker: selin
script.text: My grandparents have a small farm near the Black Sea.

script.speaker: selin
script.text: They have ten cows, some chickens and a lot of tea plants.

script.speaker: selin
script.text: Every summer, I stay with them for a month.

script.speaker: selin
script.text: I get up early to collect the eggs, and in the afternoon I help pick the tea leaves.

script.speaker: selin
script.text: It's hard work, but the view of the green hills is beautiful.

script.speaker: selin
script.text: My grandmother makes cheese from the milk. It tastes much better than cheese from the shop.

questions.evidence: My grandparents have a small farm near the Black Sea.

questions.prompt: How long does Selin stay every summer?
questions.evidence: I stay with them for a month.

questions.prompt: What does Selin do in the afternoon?
questions.feedback: Sabah yumurta topluyor; öğleden sonra çay toplamaya yardım ediyor.
